'''Wenom''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Sith sorcerer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who fought on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Wenom and two other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lords, [[Prejad]] and [[Shados]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] commandos and took over their forward camp, leading the Republic to counterstrike and kill the three.<ref name="TOR" />
